```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

file_path <- "Progetto 1 (KPC-31) versione 2.xlsx"
resistome_full <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Foglio1", skip = 0)
row2_full      <- as.character(resistome_full[2, ])
data_rows      <- resistome_full[3:nrow(resistome_full), ]

extract_mic <- function(x) as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]+", "", as.character(x)))
gene_present <- function(col_idx) {
  vals <- as.character(data_rows[[col_idx]])
  as.integer(!is.na(vals) & vals != "" & vals != "NA")
}

mer_idx <- which(row2_full == "MER")[1]

source_cat <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("BLOOD", "BC")                   ~ "Bloodstream",
    x %in% c("AF", "A.C", "Ascitic fluid")     ~ "Ascites",
    x %in% c("Pus", "TMR")                     ~ "Wound/Surgical",
    x %in% c("RS", "BAL", "Tracheal aspirate") ~ "Respiratory",
    x %in% c("UR")                             ~ "Urine",
    x %in% c("RTS", "Surveillance")            ~ "Surveillance",
    is.na(x)                                   ~ "Not recorded",
    TRUE                                       ~ x
  )
}

df <- data.frame(
  ST      = as.character(data_rows[[4]]),
  Species = as.character(data_rows[[2]]),
  Source  = source_cat(as.character(data_rows[[3]])),
  CAZ     = extract_mic(data_rows[[7]]),
  MER     = extract_mic(data_rows[[mer_idx]]),
  CTXM15  = gene_present(35),
  SHV28   = gene_present(41),
  OXA1    = gene_present(46),
  armA    = gene_present(61),
  fosA    = gene_present(70),
  incX3   = gene_present(134),
  n_bl    = rowSums(sapply(c(35:44, 46:48), gene_present), na.rm = TRUE)
)

target_sts <- c("ST307", "ST101", "ST512", "ST147", "ST131")

make_row <- function(d) {
  tibble(
    N                    = nrow(d),
    Species              = paste(sort(unique(
                             ifelse(grepl("Klebsiella", d$Species, ignore.case = TRUE),
                                    "K. pneumoniae", "E. coli"))), collapse = "/"),
    Bloodstream          = paste0(sum(d$Source == "Bloodstream"),   "/", nrow(d),
                                  " (", round(100*mean(d$Source == "Bloodstream")),   "%)"),
    Respiratory          = paste0(sum(d$Source == "Respiratory"),   "/", nrow(d),
                                  " (", round(100*mean(d$Source == "Respiratory")),   "%)"),
    Wound_Surgical       = paste0(sum(d$Source == "Wound/Surgical"),"/", nrow(d),
                                  " (", round(100*mean(d$Source == "Wound/Surgical")),"%)"),
    Ascites              = paste0(sum(d$Source == "Ascites"),       "/", nrow(d),
                                  " (", round(100*mean(d$Source == "Ascites")),       "%)"),
    CAZ_MIC              = median(d$CAZ, na.rm = TRUE),
    CAZ_R                = paste0(sum(d$CAZ > 16, na.rm = TRUE), "/", nrow(d),
                                  " (", round(100*mean(d$CAZ > 16, na.rm = TRUE)),    "%)"),
    MER_MIC              = median(d$MER, na.rm = TRUE),
    CTXM15               = paste0(sum(d$CTXM15), "/", nrow(d)),
    SHV28                = paste0(sum(d$SHV28),  "/", nrow(d)),
    OXA1                 = paste0(sum(d$OXA1),   "/", nrow(d)),
    armA                 = paste0(sum(d$armA),   "/", nrow(d)),
    fosA                 = paste0(sum(d$fosA),   "/", nrow(d)),
    IncX3                = paste0(sum(d$incX3),  "/", nrow(d)),
    BL_genes             = round(median(d$n_bl, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )
}

st_rows <- purrr::map(target_sts, ~ make_row(dplyr::filter(df, ST == .x))) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(ST = target_sts, .before = 1)

total_row <- make_row(dplyr::filter(df, ST %in% target_sts)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(ST = "Total (typed isolates)", .before = 1)

tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(st_rows, total_row)
```

```{r table1}
tbl |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Sequence type", "n", "Species",
      "Bloodstream", "Respiratory", "Wound/Surgical", "Ascites",
      "Median CAZ-AVI MIC (mg/L)", "CAZ-AVI resistant (>16 mg/L)",
      "Median MER MIC (mg/L)",
      "*blaCTX-M-15*", "*blaSHV-28*", "*blaOXA-1*",
      "*armA*", "*fosA*", "IncX3",
      "Median extra\nβ-lactamase genes"
    ),
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    align  = c("l","c","l","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c","c")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"),
    full_width = TRUE,
    font_size  = 13
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c(
    " "                            = 3,
    "Clinical source (n/N, %)"    = 4,
    "Antimicrobial susceptibility" = 3,
    "Key resistance genes (n/N)"  = 5,
    "Gene burden"                  = 2
  )) |>
  row_spec(nrow(tbl) - 1,
           extra_css = "border-bottom: 2px solid #555;") |>
  row_spec(nrow(tbl), bold = TRUE, background = "#F2F2F2") |>
  footnote(
    general = paste0(
      "CAZ-AVI, ceftazidime-avibactam; MER, meropenem; BL, beta-lactamase. ",
      "CAZ-AVI resistance defined as MIC >16 mg/L (EUCAST breakpoint). ",
      "TMR provisionally classified as Wound/Surgical — please verify. ",
      "10 isolates with unresolved sequence type are excluded from ST-stratified rows."
    ),
    general_title  = "Abbreviations: ",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```
